title: docs(plugin-dashboard): the charts example authors a line widget bound to a dataset; the card widget with nested children retires (objectui#11484)
body:
Fixes #11484

`content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx`, section "Dashboard with Charts": the json fence's "Sales Trend" widget was a `card` with a nested `chart` node in `children`. It now takes the widget shape the package README teaches since objectui#7035: `"type": "line"` names the chart family, and the widget binds `"dataset": "sales"` with `dimensions` and `values`. The lead-in and the callout are rewritten with it. They taught `type: "chart"` + `chartType` for a dashboard chart, and the widget slot refuses that spelling too (probe: a widget `{ type: "chart", chartType: "line", dataset, dimensions, values }` and a widget `{ type: "line", chartType: "line", ... }` are both refused by `DashboardComponentSchema`, tolerant and strict).

The schema is not the wrong side here: `card` is outside the closed widget-type vocabulary (`DashboardWidgetTypeSchema`: the spec's chart families plus `list` / `custom`), the widget-slot component arm admits `metric-card` only, and a widget declares no `children` slot.

## Validator verdicts, before and after

**1. The card's own instrument**, `scripts/measure-strict-authoring-face.mjs --json`, after `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build`. These are readings at the two commits named, not live counts:

| reading | before, `8366accd13` | after, `6e925b98ab` |
|---|---|---|
| `dashboard` nodes refused by the strict twin | 1 | 0 |
| `dashboard` nodes red under the face as shipped | 1 | 0 |
| docs corpus, nodes red today | 16 | 15 |
| `dashboard:` rows in `redTodayReasons` | `type invalid_value`, `children invalid_type`, `(root) unrecognized_keys`, `(root) invalid_type` | none |

**2. A direct probe**: the fence is extracted from the page and parsed with `@object-ui/types/zod` from the built `dist/`.

| face | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `DashboardComponentSchema` (tolerant) | REFUSED: `invalid_value` at `widgets.1.type`, `unrecognized_keys` `children` at `widgets.1` | ACCEPTED |
| `deriveStrictAuthoringSchema(DashboardComponentSchema)` | REFUSED, same issues | ACCEPTED |
| `StrictAnyComponentSchema` | REFUSED, same issues | ACCEPTED |
| TypeScript face: `DashboardComponentSchema` from built `dist/index.d.ts`, `tsc --strict` | TS2322 on `type: "card"` and on `children` | compiles clean |

## C3: which docs gate judges json fences on this page

None judges a json fence's schema validity, so the fixed fence has no gate pin. Per the ruling, no gate is added.

- `check:doc-types` (`scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs`) reads the `type` literals in every code block under `content/docs/**`, json fences included. It only asks whether each type names a registered component; its header says it "answers one question only — does the type exist". `card` and `chart` are registered, so the refused fence passed it. Measured: I put the old fence back on this branch's tree (an ablation through `ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to HEAD's blob). The probe refuses it and `check:doc-types` exits 0.
- `check:doc-snippets` compiles ts / tsx fences only.
- `check:doc-examples` and `check:doc-example-readers` read JSDoc `@example` blocks under `packages/NAME/src`, not `content/docs/**`.

The one instrument that sees this class is the report-only measurement script above.

## Why the README twin's `pie` widget is not copied

The README example also carries a `pie` widget, and `check:doc-types` refuses `pie` on this page. `pie` names no registered component, and the gate's `DOC_TYPE_EXEMPTIONS` row for this page covers `metric`, `metric-card`, `bar` and `line` only. Measured by ablation: with the pie widget added, all three schema faces accept the fence and `check:doc-types` exits 1 with `[unregistered-doc-type] type 'pie' (json)`. The exemption lives in `scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs`, outside this claim's file surface. So the fence keeps the metric card and the line widget.

## Local verification, at `6e925b9`

- `node scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs`, `check:doc-types`, `node scripts/check-prompt-component-keys.mjs`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:doc-fences` (with `--self-test`), `node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` and `check:new-line-citations` all exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` exits 0: "No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed." This PR has no changeset file.
- `node scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs --changed` names this page as a test input, so CI runs the full suite.
- Locally I ran a narrowed set: `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/unconsumed-widget-option-claim-6186.test.ts scripts/__tests__/check-doc-component-types.test.ts` passed 2 files and 131 tests. The first reads this page. The second covers the gate whose exemptions and key-table scan read it.
- NOT MEASURED locally: the other tests that read `content/docs/**` as data, because the shared verification lock timed out three times behind a sibling's full-suite run. CI runs them.
- NOT MEASURED locally: `check:doc-snippets`, because the diff touches no ts / tsx fence. The `doc-snippet-types` workflow runs it.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/cli/src/__tests__/unfulfilled-chart-stubs-retired-8760.test.ts` has a case named "the spelling the corrected dashboard doc teaches is accepted". Its comment says this page teaches `{ type: 'chart', chartType: 'line' }`. After this PR the page no longer teaches that spelling. The case still pins a true fact (the CLI accepts a `chart` node), and only its name and comment point at this page. Not filed; carrier: none.
